title: Jobs & Places in Town
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 revision booklet: jobs & places word banks; Exam Practice 5 reading text

scenes.t: Many people work in jobs that help us every day. They make our lives easier and safer.
Doctors and nurses look after us when we are sick. They work at the hospital.
Teachers help us learn new things at school. They teach us to read, write, and count.
Police officers keep us safe. They work day and night and catch people who break the law.
Firefighters are brave. They put out fires and save people in danger.
Mechanics fix our cars when they break down, and cleaners keep our schools and streets clean.
All these jobs are very helpful. We thank these people for their hard work!

items.a: She helps sick people and gives them medicine.
He flies planes and takes people to different places.
He cooks delicious food in a restaurant.
He puts out fires and helps people in danger.
She works in the library and helps us find books.

activities.prompt: Match each job with what the person does.
